'''Nateba Kurr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StrandedRebelPilotTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Nateba Kurr]]
Nateba Kurr appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. Due to the nature of many older quests in the [[Star Wars video games|game]], Nateba's appearance would fluctuate each time the quest was performed, making it impossible to determine his [[canon]]ical [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, the quest dialogue indicated that he was a [[Gender/Legends|male]].
